765-1479-8293.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Cleveland Booker, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.

Repeat.

5702-5954-6441-6664.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
5702-5954-6441-6664.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat from step 3.

When the Skullwinder token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Skullwinder from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat.

64-1987-2556-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
64-1987-2556-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and Warden of the Eye.
When Mnemonic Wall and Warden of the Eye enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-1987-2556-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

Sword of the Paruns attached to Sage of the Maze

2281-2895-5756.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}.
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger.
Holding priority, activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Uro.
When Saffi dies, Havi triggers, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Uro dies, Havi and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Uro from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1548-4452-5703.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1548-4452-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling Port Razer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it as it is an Assassin due to Maskwood Nexus, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the Port Razer token.
The Port Razer token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling the Port Razer token.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

1495-3062-4120.description:

Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
1495-3062-4120.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Syr Ginger and the two Foods, returning Gingerbrute to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
